definitions.gloss: plain food; simple diet; frugal meals
definitions.explanation: A diet consisting of simple, unrefined, or modest food without luxury items. Can be used positively to suggest a healthy, natural diet or negatively to suggest poverty.

examples.japanese: {粗食|そしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I lived a life enduring a plain diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粗食|そしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to eat simply for my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗食|そしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{粗末|そまつ}→粗末：03323_somatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|きら}った→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
examples.english: From his experience of eating sparingly during wartime, my grandfather disliked wasting food.

notes:
USAGE:
Often discussed in the context of traditional Japanese diets, health trends, or historical hardship. In modern usage, {粗食|そしょく} is sometimes viewed positively as a return to simple, wholesome eating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗食|そしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure a plain diet)
- {粗食|そしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧ (to aim for simple eating)
- {粗食|そしょく}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a life of simple food)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧: frugal, simple — broader term for a modest lifestyle, not limited to food
